Courses of Instruction

COSI 10a Introduction to Problem Solving in Python
[ dl sn ]

Open to students new to programming.

Introduces problem solving and programming in Python.

COSI 12b Advanced Programming Techniques in Java
[ dl sn wi ]

Prerequisite: COSI 10a or successful completion of the COSI online placement exam.

COSI 98a Independent Study

Independent study of a topic outside the regular course offerings.

COSI 121b Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
[ sn ]

Prerequisites: COSI 21a and COSI 29a.

Explores programming paradigms, abstraction, and language design.

COSI 123a Statistical Machine Learning
[ qr sn ]

Prerequisite: COSI 21a,  COSI 104a, MATH 8a, and either MATH 22a or the combination of MATH 15a and MATH 20a.

Studies statistical methods and algorithms that learn from data.
